facts.text: Qualitative prohibited practices (e.g. strategy that 'does not reflect genuine trading skill') can forfeit pending rewards, but only acting reasonably, in good faith and proportionately, after notice and at least 14 days to make representations, with a review route.
Rewards are governed by a separate Funded Trader Agreement with the BVI entity, provided only at transition to the funded phase.
Trading-rule changes not applied retroactively to enrolled accounts; 30 days' notice of modifications; honest reviews and criticism expressly protected.
